Emerging growth company ☐ If an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act. ☐ Section 5 Corporate Governance and Management Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers Pursuant to the charter of the Nominating and Governance Committee of Allegiant Travel Company (the “Company”), a director is to offer his or her resignation from the Board of Directors (the “Board”) if there is a significant change in their personal circumstances, including a change in their principal job responsibilities. On October 16, 2026, Jude Bricker submitted a letter of resignation to the Board in light of his participation as an owner and chief executive officer of a newly formed company which has agreed to purchase a U.S. charter airline. The Board accepted his resignation as of October 23, 2026.
